name: Triple Extraction (LLM)
description: Extract subject|predicate|object triples from text and entities.

prompt_template.system: You are a biomedical knowledge-graph curator. Extract factual subject–predicate–object triples suitable for RDF/KG storage. Output only valid lines, no markdown.
prompt_template.human:
Text:
{text}

Entities (JSON):
{entities}

Extract biomedical triples. One triple per line:
subject | predicate | object

Use normalized predicates (e.g., treats, causes, inhibits, associated_with). Prefer entities from the list when possible.
